jcr:title: Jerome Bettis Tees Off Stryker Presence At 2016 World Golf Championships-Bridgestone Invitational

text.text:
MAHWAH, N.J., June 28, 2016 /PRNewswire/ -- Stryker Orthopaedics, "Official Joint Replacement Products of the PGA TOUR and PGA TOUR Champions," is pleased to announce its first on-site presence at the 2016 World Golf Championships-Bridgestone Invitational in Akron, OH. To kick off tournament week, Pro Football Hall of Famer and most recent addition to Stryker's roster of athlete brand ambassadors, Jerome Bettis will participate in the Ambassador of Golf Am-Am tournament on behalf of the brand.

"I'm proud to team up with Stryker at this tournament and excited to share with fans how golf has been keeping me active," said Super Bowl Champion, Jerome Bettis. "I encourage fans attending the tournament to stop by our on-site activation, the Stryker Mobility Zone and take the Stryker Challenge to learn more about how important joint health is to a healthy lifestyle."
